title: Ezekiel 26
paragraphs: ¹ In the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me: ² "Son of man, because Tyre said of Jerusalem, 'Aha! The gateway of the nations is broken, and its trade has come to me — now that Jerusalem lies in ruins, I will grow rich,' ³ therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, as the sea sends up its waves. ⁴ They will destroy the walls of Tyre and demolish her towers. I will scrape away the rubble and leave her a bare rock. ⁵ She will become a place where fishermen spread their nets in the open sea, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD. She will be plundered by the nations.

⁶ Her settlements on the mainland will be put to the sword, and then they will know that I am the LORD. ⁷ For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will bring against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north — with horses and chariots, with cavalry and a great army. ⁸ He will put your mainland settlements to the sword, build siege ramps against you, raise a shield wall, and set up battering devices against you. ⁹ He will direct his siege weapons against your walls and shatter your towers with his axes. ¹⁰ His horses will be so many that their dust will cover you. At the thunder of cavalry, wagons, and chariots your walls will tremble when he enters your gates like troops entering a city whose walls have been broken through.

¹¹ His horses' hooves will trample all your streets. He will put your people to the sword and tear down your mighty pillars. ¹² Your wealth will be plundered and your merchandise looted; your walls will be demolished and your fine houses torn down and thrown into the sea. ¹³ I will silence the music of your songs, and the sound of your harps will be heard no more. ¹⁴ I will make you a bare rock, a place for spreading fishing nets. You will never be rebuilt, for I the LORD have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD. ¹⁵ This is what the Sovereign LORD says to Tyre: Will not the coastlands tremble at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan and the slaughter takes place in your midst?

¹⁶ Then all the princes of the coast will step down from their thrones, lay aside their robes, and take off their embroidered garments. They will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled at the sight of you. ¹⁷ They will sing a lament over you and say: "How you are destroyed, O city of the sea, you who were inhabited by seafarers — the renowned city, strong on the sea, you and your citizens who spread terror over all the surrounding peoples! ¹⁸ Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your downfall; the islands in the sea are filled with dread at your passing." ¹⁹ For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: When I make you a desolate city, like cities no longer inhabited, and when I bring the deep sea over you and its vast waters cover you, ²⁰ then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, with the people of ancient times. I will set you in the depths of the earth, like ancient ruins, with those who go down to the pit, so that you will never again be inhabited or take your place in the land of the living.
²¹ I will bring you to a terrible end and you will exist no more. You will be looked for but never found again, declares the Sovereign LORD.
